description: Take a card out of its sprint (clears its sprint membership). A card standing on the sprint's OWN materialized board leaves it for the group's backlog; a card on an ordinary board stays exactly where it is.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.
